objectives.label: Polite conditional request
objectives.descriptorEN: Soften a request with 'rada bi / prosila bi' instead of a bare imperative.

objectives.label: Quantity by weight (genitive)
objectives.descriptorEN: Order goods by weight using 'pol kilograma / dvajset dekagramov' with the correct genitive.

objectives.label: Yes/no question + short answer
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask 'Ali imate…?' and understand 'Ja, imamo' or 'ni več'.

objectives.label: Preference & demonstratives
objectives.descriptorEN: Express a choice with 'raje' and point using 'ta/tisti' in the right gender.

objectives.label: Adjective agreement
objectives.descriptorEN: Attach a describing word ('svež', 'topla') to a noun with correct gender/case.

objectives.label: Payment method & catching the total
objectives.descriptorEN: State a payment method and ask/understand the spoken price.

b1.speaker: npc
b1.en: Good day! What can I get you?
b1.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Dober dan! Izvolite?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.en: Good day. I'd like some bread.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.sl: Dober dan. Ali imate svež kruh?
c1b.en: Good day. Do you have fresh bread?

b2.speaker: npc
b2.en: Yes, we do. White or wholegrain?
b2.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Ja, imamo. Bel ali polnozrnat?

b3.speaker: npc
b3.en: How much bread would you like?
b3.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Koliko kruha želite?

b4.speaker: npc
b4.sl: Izvolite, sveže narezan. Boste še kaj?
b4.en: Here you go, freshly sliced. Anything else?
b4.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Izvolite, sveže narezan. Boste še kaj?

b5.speaker: npc
b5.sl: Izvolite. Bi še kakšno sladko pecivo?
b5.en: Here you are. Would you like some sweet pastry too?
b5.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Izvolite. Bi še kakšno sladko pecivo?

c5a.speaker: client
c5a.en: Do you have a chocolate danish?

c5b.speaker: client
c5b.en: Do you have the spelt pastry with cheese?

b6a.speaker: npc
b6a.sl: Daniša s čokolado žal ni več, imamo pa pirin s sirom. Bi enega?
b6a.en: I'm afraid there's no chocolate danish left, but we do have the spelt pastry with cheese. Would you like one?
b6a.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Daniša s čokolado žal ni več, imamo pa pirin s sirom. Bi enega?

b6b.speaker: npc
b6b.sl: Ja, seveda, pirin s sirom Tolminec. Bi enega?
b6b.en: Yes, of course, the spelt pastry with Tolminec cheese. Would you like one?
b6b.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Ja, seveda, pirin s sirom Tolminec. Bi enega?

b7.speaker: npc
b7.sl: Prav. To bi bilo vse. Kako boste plačali?
b7.en: Alright. That's everything. How will you pay?
b7.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Prav. To bi bilo vse. Kako boste plačali?

b8.speaker: npc
b8.sl: Štiri evre in petdeset centov. Boste rabili vrečko?
b8.en: Four euros fifty. Will you need a bag?
b8.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Štiri evre in petdeset centov. Boste rabili vrečko?

b9.speaker: npc
b9.sl: Izvolite. Lep dan še naprej, nasvidenje!
b9.en: Here you go. Have a nice day, goodbye!
b9.deliverySL: [hesitant and a little apathetic] Izvolite. Lep dan še naprej, nasvidenje!
